The dedup/exclude-cancelled logic in GET /events/{id} (status:{$ne:'cancelled'}) is therefore unreachable from the UI for public-event bookings — admins would need direct DB access. Consider adding PUT /api/public-bookings/{id}/cancel or merging the two collections.

ui_bugs.component: OutreachPage → Generate Recurring Events dialog → Recurrence Pattern Select
ui_bugs.issue: The pattern Select trigger is VISUALLY BLANK on dialog open even though recurForm.pattern='weekly' is set in state. <SelectValue /> renders an empty span (verified via inner_html). Root cause: shadcn/ui Select uses Radix Select where <SelectValue /> displays the matching SelectItem's children text ('Weekly'), but in this case the Select is rendered AFTER setRecurForm(); Radix's controlled-value-to-text mapping is failing silently. Quick fix: add a placeholder so users see SOMETHING, and/or set `defaultValue` on <Select>: e.g. `<Select value={recurForm.pattern} defaultValue='weekly' ...><SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder='Weekly' /></SelectTrigger>`. Better fix: ensure SelectItems are mounted before the value prop changes, or use a key on Select that changes when the dialog opens to force re-render after state is set.
When clicking 'Generate Events' with empty start_date the toast 'Pick a start date' fires TWICE (double-render or double-call of the toast). Functionally fine but visually duplicates the toast.

rca of the issue: Recurrence Pattern blank: Radix Select's <SelectValue /> renders the SelectItem's children for the matching `value`. When the dialog opens, the Select component mounts WITH `value='weekly'`, but Radix needs the SelectItem children to be registered into its internal viewport context BEFORE it can map the value to display-text. In React the order is: setRecurForm() → setShowRecurring() → Dialog mounts → Select mounts → SelectItems register. Because `value` is set on the Select trigger BEFORE its items have registered with Radix's portal-driven viewport, the trigger sees `value='weekly'` but no item registered yet → falls back to empty. Workarounds: (1) Add a `<SelectValue placeholder='Weekly' />` so something shows. (2) Set `defaultValue='weekly'` on <Select>. (3) Force a remount when the dialog opens via `<Select key={showRecurring?.id} ...>`. Option (3) is the cleanest fix.
